messages.text: Give me a summary of the movie Edge of Tomorrow.

**Edge of Tomorrow** (2014) is a sci-fi action film starring Tom Cruise and Emily Blunt.

The story follows Major William Cage, a military public relations officer with no combat experience, who is forced onto the front lines of a war against invading aliens called Mimics. He's killed within minutes of landing—but then wakes up at the start of the same day.

Cage discovers he's caught in a time loop: every time he dies, he resets to the morning before the battle. He eventually connects with Rita Vrataski, a legendary soldier who once had the same ability and used it to win a major victory. She agrees to train him, and through countless loops—dying and resetting over and over—Cage transforms from a coward into a skilled fighter.

Together, they work to find and destroy the Omega, the central alien intelligence controlling the Mimics. The film plays with the "live, die, repeat" mechanic in clever ways, blending dark humor, intense action sequences, and a gradual deepening of Cage's character as he experiences the same day from every possible angle.
